description.p: WriteAlt generates accurate, SEO-friendly alt text for images in up to 130 languages.
Organize images into local folders, scan websites for missing alt text, optimize or convert images, keep a searchable local history, and export results as CSV.
A WriteAlt account and API key are required for AI generation. Image organization, conversion, compression, and local history remain on your computer.
Initial Linux release with AI alt text generation, website scanning, image organization, optimization, conversion, history, and CSV export.
